from PIL import Image
import os

icons_dir = r"C:\\Users\\NGoussous\\OneDrive - International Renewable Energy Agency - IRENA\\02_Development\\stakeholder_dialogue\\public\\icons"
CANVAS = 128
TARGET_H = 68  # normalized content height

png_files = [f for f in os.listdir\(icons_dir\) if f.endswith\('.png'\)]

for fname in sorted\(png_files\):
    path = os.path.join\(icons_dir, fname\)
    img = Image.open\(path\).convert\('RGBA'\)
    bbox = img.getbbox\(\)
    if not bbox:
        continue

    cropped = img.crop\(bbox\)
    cw, ch = cropped.size

    # Scale so content height == TARGET_H, preserve aspect ratio
    new_h = TARGET_H
    new_w = round\(cw * \(TARGET_H / ch\)\)

    # Guard: if width exceeds canvas with padding, scale down from width instead
    MAX_W = CANVAS - 16  # 8px padding each side
    if new_w > MAX_W:
        new_w = MAX_W
        new_h = round\(ch * \(MAX_W / cw\)\)

    resized = cropped.resize\(\(new_w, new_h\), Image.LANCZOS\)

    canvas = Image.new\('RGBA', \(CANVAS, CANVAS\), \(0, 0, 0, 0\)\)
    paste_x = \(CANVAS - new_w\) // 2
    paste_y = \(CANVAS - new_h\) // 2
    canvas.paste\(resized, \(paste_x, paste_y\), resized\)
    canvas.save\(path\)

    print\(f"{fname:<25} {cw}x{ch} → {new_w}x{new_h}, pasted at \({paste_x},{paste_y}\)"\)

print\("\\nDone."\)
